title: Read preview launch options
responsibility: Checks the local launch options and identifies the checkout and history data.

inputs.name: previewArguments.args
inputs.description: The dev command's launch tokens, read in order: a token not starting with '-' sets the root to its path resolved against the working directory (the last one wins), and each of --config, --port and --host takes the next token as its value. Only --config, --port, --host, --strictPort and -- are accepted (the last two are ignored), --host must be 127.0.0.1, --port must be an integer from 1024 to 65535 after Number() conversion, and a missing or empty value, or one starting with '--', is rejected.

inputs.name: previewArguments.env
inputs.description: Defaults to process.env: only the keys starting with HARNESS_ or PROJECT_REPORTS_, and the key BODY_SIZE_LIMIT, are hashed into identity with their values, sorted by key, and all other keys are ignored.

outputs.name: previewArguments
outputs.description: The validated launch result: root is the real path of the root token, or of the working directory when none is given; port is the web port, 5588 unless --port is given; and configFile is the absolute --config path (not checked for existence), present only when --config is given. identity is a 64-character lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of root, configFile and the relevant environment settings, and the port is not part of it.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown with the message 'Missing value for <option>.' when an option, supported or not, is the last token or its next token is empty or starts with '--'.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown with the message 'Unsupported managed preview option: <option>' when an option other than --config, --port or --host has a value.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown with the message 'Harness previews bind to 127.0.0.1 only.' when --host is any value other than 127.0.0.1.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown with the message 'Preview port must be from 1024 to 65535.' when the --port value, converted with Number(), is not an integer from 1024 to 65535 (NaN included).

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown as a Node.js filesystem error, such as ENOENT, by process.cwd() when the working directory has been removed or by realpathSync when the root does not exist or cannot be resolved.
